steps.title: set-up: the window at 90% x 90% of the screen
set-up: a new workspace for the case
set-up: shell #FF00FF (app theme Nord), terminal ground #00FFFF, tab strips #000000, agent ground #0000FF, no close warning, new columns share the strip, no hover cards

steps.text:
#!/bin/sh
i=1
while [ $i -le 80 ]; do
  echo "line $i: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog; this long line wraps at the pane edge, so a resize re-wraps it (close-variants film, non-private text) $i"
  i=$((i+1))
done
steps.title: set-up: the long-lines script

exec claude
